title: Assert the domain numeric-acknowledge refusal message, not only its 400
outcome: numeric_ack_is_rejected_for_domain_members_but_standalone_behavior_remains (src/tests/federation_mailboxes.rs) asserts the domain refusal's message, "central domain acknowledgement requires only the unchanged issued receipt", as well as the 400. It then fails if the malformed-id guard, or any other 400, answers the request first.
acceptance: Assert the domain numeric-acknowledge refusal message, not only its 400 is done
